channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Titan’s beYon bet: Selling sparkle as lab-grown diamond prices fall
item.description: As prices of lab-grown diamonds fall, Titan is betting on colour, design and experimentation to build a brand that stands apart from affordability alone. But in a crowded market, beYon has yet to prove that its proposition can sustain demand.

item.title: No economic settlement in TVS family, daughter Lakshmi has equal rights, says Mallika Srinivasan
item.description: At the heart of the dispute is a memorandum of understanding (MoU) signed in March 2024, which Mallika says covers only brand rights and related obligations, not the ownership of family assets or an economic settlement.

item.title: Venezuelan crude comeback puts Reliance’s refining edge back in focus
item.description: Processing Venezuelan oil could help Reliance Industries generate a sustainable structural premium of $3 per barrel over domestic public sector refiners like Indian Oil Corporation Ltd, according to Yes Securities.&nbsp;

item.title: DHL joins NX Group in race to build semiconductor logistics in India
item.description: DHL plans to set up a chip warehouse in Dholera, its first dedicated semiconductor warehouse in India.

item.title: Exclusive-Moonshot execs in talks to settle dispute with shareholder ahead of planned IPO, people say
item.description: MOONSHOT-DISPUTE:Exclusive-Moonshot execs in talks to settle dispute with shareholder ahead of planned IPO, people say

item.title: JPMorgan, Goldman Curb Exposure on $5 Billion Volta AI Loan Sale
item.description: JPMorgan Chase & Co. and Goldman Sachs Group Inc. have taken a rare move to limit their exposure on a $5 billion loan sale for AI startup Volta Infrastructure Holdings Ltd. as investors demand higher yields for risky debt tied to the artificial intelligence boom.

item.title: HCLTech beats estimates, but Q2 growth slips to three-year low
item.description: HCL Tech’s advanced AI revenue jumped 28% sequentially to $219 million, while net profit jumped 10.25% during the same period to $538 million.

item.title: RBL Bank expects to put most FCNR(B) funds to profitable use in 2-3 years
item.description: RBL Bank expects its net interest margin to decline in the December quarter as the cost of about ₹34,000 crore raised through FCNR(B) deposits kicks in, while much of the funds remain parked in lower-yielding investments.&nbsp;

item.title: Sir Dorabji Tata Trust gets a week more to respond to complaints by two trustees
item.description: SDTT, which holds 27.98% of Tata Sons, has sought an extension to respond to the Charity Commissioner’s queries on complaints filed against it. The deadline is now extended to 19 October.

item.title: Why did Japanese chain 7-Eleven shut 31 stores in India despite its ‘long-term’ ambitions?
item.description: At the end of September, Reliance Retail, which operates 7-Eleven stores in India under a master franchise agreement, shut all 31 outlets across the country.

item.title: Old Monk maker says Maharashtra lost ₹300 crore in excise revenue since plant shutdown in May
item.description: Mohan Rocky Springwater Pvt Ltd told the High Court that its standoff with the FSSAI has left its Khopoli factory shut since May, cutting off state tax revenues and leaving 300 workers idle.

item.title: HCLTech Q2 Results: Revenue up 11.5% but misses estimates, net profit up 21.2%
item.description: HCLTech Q2 Results 2026-27: Consolidated revenue rose 11.5% to ₹35,620 crore, net profit increased 21.2% to ₹5,132 crore.

item.title: LinkedIn posts about ‘women executives’ land McKinsey partner in trouble; leadership role taken away
item.description: McKinsey removed senior partner Chris Bradley from his leadership roles after reviewing his LinkedIn comments questioning the glass cliff phenomenon. Details of the post here.&nbsp;

item.title: Eight out of 10 new TCS hires will need to have AI skills: What is its share of AI-led work in overall revenue?
item.description: TCS says 80% of future hires will have digital and AI skills, with 25-30% of its 4,500 Q2 hires specialising purely in AI. AI-led work reached 10% of revenue in the September quarter, and executives expect growth in AI deals to support profit margins.

item.title: Reliance’s Jio convention centre construction delay: SC directs MMRDA to deposit ₹646 cr
item.description: The lease of the BKC land required Reliance to complete construction of the Jio World Convention Centre within four years, but the project was subsequently expanded and required additional approvals.

item.title: Biotech startup PopVax begins human trials of fridge-stable covid vaccine
item.description: PopVax's PVX-001 is designed to remain stable at 2-8°C for at least nine months and protect against a broad range of covid-19 variants

item.title: Bajaj Alts hits first close of maiden real estate fund at ₹950 crore
item.description: The fund will invest in commercial office development through equity joint ventures with established developers, targeting Grade A office assets in key Indian markets.

item.title: Medical devices maker SMT in talks for ₹200 crore pre-IPO round
item.description: Samara Capital, Morgan Stanley and Kotak are expected to join new investors in the round, as the medical devices maker prepares to list and early backers eye substantial gains.

item.title: Swarovski sees India business doubling in 4-5 years as it steps up store investments
item.description: Swarovski plans to double its India business in four to five years through store expansion, affordable products and festive marketing. India sales rose 26% to ₹478 crore in FY25.

item.title: TSMC expected to report sixth straight quarter of record profit thanks to AI boom
item.description: TSMC-RESULTS/ (PREVIEW, PIX):PREVIEW-TSMC expected to report sixth straight quarter of record profit thanks to AI boom

item.title: Tata Motors sweetens Iveco offer as key investors hold out
item.description: The tender offer has attracted acceptances for just 28.4% of the shares, with less than two weeks remaining to close the Tata Motors-Iveco deal.

item.title: Supply-chain shifts, policy push fuel India’s manufacturing startup boom
item.description: India's manufacturing startups have seen a surge in investor interest and a sharp rise in revenue as the country steps up efforts to boost local manufacturing, with funding jumping from $164 million in 2020 when the pandemic arrived to $1.92 billion in 2026, per data platform Venture Intelligence.

item.title: Encalm looks beyond airport lounges to build ₹5,000 crore hospitality business
item.description: Airport hospitality currently generates about 90% of Encalm’s revenue, but the company is pursuing hotels in Delhi and Chennai, highway motels and growth in catering and restaurants. The expansion also marks an attempt to reduce its dependence on airports operated by the GMR Group.

item.title: McKinsey Strips Partner of Leadership Role Over LinkedIn Posts
item.description: McKinsey & Co. removed a senior partner from his leadership role at the firm’s research arm after he posted online comments questioning the uphill battle female executives face in the workplace.

item.title: Flipkart's former employees petition to include 20,000-30,000 of group's ex-staff in ESOP buyout: Report
item.description: Former Flipkart executives have launched a petition to get around 20,000-30,000 other former employees of the e-commerce platform and its group companies together to push for their inclusion in the planned $2 billion ESOPs buyback.

item.title: Jio-bp raises petrol price by ₹5 per litre, diesel up ₹3
item.description: While other fuel retailers have raised prices following the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, this is the first time Jio-bp has raised prices this year.

item.title: Nvidia's paid lunches vs Google's free buffets: Are stock perks the new Big Tech benefit?
item.description: From Google's free buffets to Nvidia's paid cafeteria meals, explore how Big Tech's employee perks are changing and why company stock may matter more.

item.title: Etihad Airways commercial chief Arik De exits after five-year stint, leaves key post vacant
item.description: Reflecting on his time at the airline, Arik De highlighted the scale of Etihad’s financial transformation and the growth in its revenue during his tenure.

item.title: ‘Milky Mist denies FSSAI inquiry on its paneer products’: Here’s what Tamil Nadu-based dairy products company said
item.description: Milky Mist identifies itself as “India's fastest-growing packaged food company.” It has a range of 400+ products, according to the company’s website.

item.title: Aditya Birla unit seeks ₹14,500 crore in loans, says report; here's why it needs the funds
item.description: Aditya Birla Renewables is seeking $1.5 billion in rupee loans from Indian banks including SBI and HDFC, as per a news report. Here's why it needs the funds.

item.title: ‘Competition would greatly benefit average Indian’: Elon Musk takes a fresh swipe at Ambani over Starlink’s entry
item.description: In the latest tweet amid his very public dispute with Ambani, the SpaceX and Tesla CEO pointed out the “absurd hypocrisy” over “de facto monopoly”.

item.title: Elon Musk's SpaceX ambition grows: From being ‘worth more than Earth’ to ‘orders of magnitude’ beyond the global economy
item.description: In a post on X on October 9, the Tesla and SpaceX chief executive said he could see a path for SpaceX to reach a valuation far beyond the economic output generated worldwide.

item.title: Court Denies Investor Request to Probe Philips Over 2021 Recall
item.description: An Amsterdam court rejected requests from investors for an investigation into Royal Philips NV’s handling of a 2021 recall of its sleep apnea devices.

item.title: Nvidia’s corporate communications chief Anna Soellner quits after 4 months: Who is she?
item.description: Anna Soellner joined the chipmaker around June, according to her LinkedIn profile, as the company experienced rapid growth driven by demand for artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure.

item.title: DMart’s Q2 profit growth trails revenue as expenses rise
item.description: DMart posted strong revenue growth in the September quarter, helped by better sales at mature stores and continued network expansion.&nbsp;
